scope: All unique extra PLACE/REL cases in the first six completed unit groups (5,43,102,233,293,310); not a random error prevalence sample

cases.reason: The quoted 去天府联盟 supplies locative use of an organization name. Profile allows explicit locative use; reference excludes this name. This is not sufficient evidence of a hallucinated name.
Source locates 盐城 in 加玛帝国东部省份. Whether the enclosing empire counts as a directly asserted relation needs a frozen granularity rule.
从云岚宗内走出强者 can describe institutional origin or physical departure; source spelling alone does not decide the reading.
去墨家 uses a family name as a destination; residence versus organization is not resolved by exact substring support.
Institutional subsection label may be a generic description rather than the required named place.
All three independent arms cite 西极大陆上 as a named locative expression. It is absent from frozen name gold; do not silently relabel or count it as proven model error.

The source endpoint is truncated. Retaining the literal fragment avoids inventing 帝都 but does not establish that 帝 is a complete named place. The dependent NEAR edge is also unsupported as a named-endpoint assertion.
The geographic descriptor is present, but the relation contract requires two named places; a relative area description may not qualify.
加玛圣城 followed by 坐落在城中心地段极好的萧府 provides a plausible explicit discourse-linked location assertion. Reference disagreement is retained, not repaired.
Near-location wording exists but identifying 庞然大物 and 皇城 uses discourse coreference. Acceptance policy should distinguish this from alias resolution and unstated geographic inference.

Reference uses 小小的镇子 while strict/split use 镇子. Both are exact source substrings naming the same category; the rubric does not say whether modifiers belong to the type expression. Scores remain exact and unchanged.
Reference uses 一座模糊山峰 while baseline uses 山峰. This is phrase extent disagreement, not evidence that the place category itself is fabricated.
